top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turns ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis into a designable chemical event, with measured ternary-complex structures, cooperativity and degradation kinetics reproduced by independent groups; the cereblon glue branch already has approved drugs. Crews, Deshaies and Handa mark the concept and the cereblon mechanism, and the citation must say it rewards the principle, not the later VHL/optimisation work or a clinical verdict on PROTACs. I rank B069 (Buchwald, Hartwig) second as the most mature and cleanly attributed alternative, then Gray and Winkler (narrow but quantitative), then the lipid nanoparticle trio (contested attribution, closer to pharmaceutical technology), with no award last.
